entry.title: On the Eigenvalues of Random Matrices with Applications
entry.summary: We study the spectral properties of large random matrices $A \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times n}$ with applications to $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \lambda_i^2$.

entry.title: Spectral Analysis of Differential Operators
entry.summary: This paper analyzes the spectrum of $\Delta u + \lambda u = 0$ on bounded domains using $\int_\Omega |\nabla u|^2 dx$.
